reconstruction.state_alignment: Previous recorded row; not independently measured hardware delay.
reconstruction.source_policy_binding: User confirmed Nov10 youngHit exported model actually used; executable not independently captured.
reconstruction.new_policy_binding: No real-hardware recording of the current Nov11 server policy; all its outputs here are counterfactual.

method.comparison: Four W2L policies receive identical reconstructed590-vectors from the deployed Nov10 policy real trajectory. Wheel model receives the same physical states and previous physical targets re-encoded for its390-input contract.
method.kernel: Central differences, each channel x10 history lags x2 inputs ->2 physical hip targets. Latest=lag0. Each operating point local linearization freezes all other inputs.
method.scalar: Median/p95 largest singular value of2x2 bilateral Jacobian; ratios are ratios of medians. Output hip target radians per physical input unit.
method.frequency: Sum_l J_l exp(-i2pi*f*l*.02); previous-target branch also stores extra20ms phase. Policy kernel only, not hardware mechanical transfer or stability margin.
method.target_spectrum: 45-point recorded-state and recorded-previous-target feed, linear detrend+Hann+rFFT, summed7..13Hz unnormalized power. No recursively generated target feedback.
method.directional: Unit-L2 same/opposite encoder sign perturbations; not calibrated anatomical labels.
method.verification: Half/double FD steps every5th point, float64 checkpoint autograd every5th point, exact ONNX actor weights and output parity, independent real-input reconstruction.

young_nov11.archived_vs_analysis_artifact_note: Formal archive graph differs in serialization from original analysis export; both actual hashes preserved in equivalence evidence; fresh45-state output and full FD Jacobian equivalence verified.

limits: Only the Nov10 youngHit model was confirmed deployed for this recording. New-model results are counterfactual, not actual hardware outcomes.
W2L reconstruction retains about5.09/4.59deg target RMSE; exact network input and inference timestamps were not recorded.
One-row alignment does not measure20ms hardware latency.
A single 0.9s trajectory window and local derivatives cannot establish global robustness or loop stability.
Multiple training/configuration differences prevent attributing changes to a single reward.
